findings.title: Cloudflare Pages response security headers were missing
findings.evidence: Nginx security headers existed only in nginx.conf; Cloudflare Pages serves dist and does not use that Nginx configuration.
findings.impact: The production Pages deployment lacked CSP, frame protection, MIME sniffing protection, referrer policy, permissions policy, and HSTS headers.
findings.resolution: Added Cloudflare Pages _headers with CSP and browser security headers. Inline styles remain permitted because the React interface uses style attributes and an inline scoped style block; scripts remain same-origin only.

findings.title: Vulnerable Tailwind CSS 3 dependency tree
findings.evidence: npm audit reports Tailwind CSS 3.4.19 and transitive braces 3.0.3, chokidar 3.6.0, micromatch 4.0.8, postcss-nested 6.2.0, and postcss-selector-parser 6.1.4. Current application code has no backend and does not load these packages in the production browser runtime.
findings.impact: The affected packages are build/development tooling. Exploitation would require attacker-controlled patterns/selectors to reach the vulnerable tooling, so this is not an exposed production-site path based on the current static build.
findings.resolution: No dependency migration performed in this review; npm audit indicates the available Tailwind fix is a major upgrade to version 4.

findings.title: Vite 5 development-server vulnerabilities
findings.evidence: npm audit reports Vite 5.4.21 affected by advisories through 6.4.2 and esbuild 0.21.5. vite.config.ts sets server.host to true, so the local development server listens beyond loopback interfaces. Vite is a devDependency and is not shipped in the production static assets.
findings.impact: Potential exposure is limited to a running development server on a reachable network; the production Cloudflare Pages site does not run Vite. One advisory is Windows-specific and does not apply to this macOS development host.
findings.resolution: No Vite major upgrade performed in this review; npm audit indicates the available fix is a major upgrade to Vite 8.

checks.secret_scan: No recognized credentials, private-key blocks, .env files, or credential files found in tracked working-tree files or searched Git history.
checks.source_patterns: No eval, Function constructor, child_process, or dangerouslySetInnerHTML found. localStorage use is limited to the color theme.
checks.audit: npm audit completed with 9 vulnerabilities: 6 high and 3 moderate across dependency tree.
